articles.title: Akhilesh Yadav slams India-US trade deal; says ‘Make in India’ abandoned
articles.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav sharply attacked the BJP-led Central government over the recently announced US-India interim trade deal. He accused the government of "handing over" national interests, implying significant concessions or compromises detrimental to India's economy or sovereignty through the agreement. This demonstrates political opposition reacting to international trade policies.

articles.title: Sweden's defence firm SAAB says Gripen fighter jet has place in IAF
articles.summary: Sweden's SAAB has proposed to the Indian Government the establishment of the world's most advanced aerospace industry within India. This multi-layered initiative covers indigenous design, production, and maintenance capabilities, including the potential induction of fighter aircraft. The proposal aims to significantly enhance India's defence manufacturing prowess and self-reliance, aligning with strategic objectives for indigenous defence production.

articles.title: Sweden's defence firm SAAB seeks Indian Air Force induction for its Gripen fighter jet
articles.summary: Swedish defence giant SAAB has proposed establishing the world's most advanced aerospace industry in India to the Indian Government. This ambitious plan includes multi-layered design, production, and maintenance capabilities, significantly boosting indigenisation efforts. The initiative aims to enhance India's self-reliance and technological prowess in the critical aerospace sector, aligning with national defence and "Make in India" objectives.

articles.title: ‘Secure indoor ventilation standards, or we end up inhaling high carbon dioxide’
articles.summary: Professor Pawel Wargocki from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), a leading authority on indoor air quality and environmental health, engaged with The Indian Express, Mumbai team. The discussion likely focused on crucial aspects of indoor environments and their impact on human well-being, providing insights into modern challenges and scientific solutions related to health and building design.

articles.title: Top 10: Very cool planes from the Cold War
articles.summary: The Cold War, fueled by extensive defence funding, spearheaded the creation of a fascinating variety of warplanes. This era witnessed the development of aircraft that ranged from remarkably innovative and iconic designs to those considered unconventional or even controversial. Exploring these diverse Cold War aviation projects offers valuable insights into defence technology evolution and strategic thinking that shaped global military aerospace.

articles.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Cap global allocation at 20% as currency turns X-factor in 2026: Prashant Gupta
articles.summary: India's Union Budget 2026 potentially eased outbound investment norms, encouraging global diversification for Indian entities. While this move strengthens the case for international ventures, aspirants should note that currency volatility remains a critical factor. It could significantly alter the return equation for overseas investors, demanding careful risk assessment for any international financial planning.
